scope.question: Whether the official agent-scaling release resolves the arXiv v3 SWE-bench model denominator and matched-budget ambiguities.
scope.method: Bounded inspection of public GitHub pages and raw source through web tools; no project imports, experiment execution, provider calls or shell network.

version.limitation: This release postdates arXiv v3 and is recommended by documentation for a later manuscript revision. It is not established here as the exact implementation/configuration used for every original paper run. Main HEAD was not pinned. Older v1.0.0 was listed as April 7 with short commit cbf8c10, but its contents were not successfully inspected.

conclusions.denominator: Partially resolved: the tagged analysis explicitly expects 270 total configurations and 90 new configurations from two benchmarks, five architectures and nine models. It includes Gemini 3 Flash. This supports a nine-model interpretation of Table 16, but does not reconcile arXiv v3's eight-model / 260-configuration setup prose.
conclusions.budgets: Unresolved: inspected code specifies step, per-worker iteration, round and time ceilings, with an optional per-call token parameter. These paths did not demonstrate enforcement of one shared total reasoning-token budget across architectures. This is not evidence that the original runs consumed unequal budgets.
conclusions.availability: Implementation, per-instance outcome CSV and selected sanitized example traces are public. A complete paired SWE-bench token ledger and original resolved configurations for every architecture/model cell were not established in this bounded inspection.

evidence.supported: Model mapping includes gemini-3-flash-preview. New data are grouped by dataset, agent type, provider and model, without an observed Gemini 3 exclusion. Main analysis describes five architectures times nine models per new benchmark and asserts 270 combined configurations.
evidence.limitation: Source was read, not executed; means and counts were not independently recomputed. The analysis does not explain the earlier prose discrepancy.

evidence.supported: The displayed file has 1,801 lines including its header, with Gemini 3 Flash rows in all five SWE-bench architecture blocks. Columns are dataset, agent_type, provider, model, instance_idx, resolved, num_steps, success and has_output.
evidence.limitation: This outcome table has no token, cost or configured-budget columns. Its num_steps column alone cannot establish equal total inference allocation or expenditure.

evidence.supported: SingleAgent defaults to max_steps=100; a supplied time limit can increase this ceiling. The run loop iterates over that max_steps value.
evidence.limitation: These defaults do not establish the resolved settings or consumed tokens of the historical paper runs.

evidence.supported: The leader loops over rounds, checks elapsed time and invokes planning, coordination, stopping and synthesis. Workers reset their iteration counter and run up to max_iterations_per_agent for each round. The inspected decentralized YAML sets three base agents, 25 worker iterations and 10 rounds.
evidence.inference: Architecture-level nominal ceilings cannot be treated as a matched aggregate inference budget without the resolved run settings and all-agent usage accounting.
evidence.limitation: No claim about original actual token consumption follows from these source defaults.

evidence.supported: LLM configuration has optional max_tokens defaulting to None. The wrapper merges invocation parameters, supplies request timeouts and can log usage/cost through Langfuse.
evidence.limitation: These inspected paths did not show a shared total reasoning-token budget controller. Logging capability is not a published complete usage ledger, and this was not an exhaustive proof of absence elsewhere in the repository.

evidence.supported: README describes sanitized sample traces. The inspected main tree lists BrowseComp examples, a centralized PlanCraft example, and a SWE-bench single-agent example. That SWE path lists run_config.yaml, dataset_eval_metrics.json and instance_runs/0000/instance_save.yaml.
evidence.access_limitations: Fetching sample run_config and metric contents failed through the web tool. Their filenames were observed, not their contents. Main-tree trace listing was not pinned to v2.1.3. Full paired SWE architecture traces were not found in the bounded inspected paths; this is not a claim that none exist anywhere.

needed_to_resolve_remaining_ambiguity: Exact paper-run source commits and resolved per-cell configurations, with model inclusion/exclusion history.
A precise matched-budget definition and its enforcement or post-hoc matching procedure.
Per-call realized token accounting for workers and coordinators, including reasoning/output tokens, retries and other overhead, linked to all original task outcomes.
Task identities and disposition of failed, timed-out or rerun attempts.
evaluation_implication: Use this as descriptive external evidence that architecture gains depend on tasks and models, with nine-model table aggregation now supported by public analysis. Do not use it as verified causal evidence from an equal-total-budget gossip-versus-orchestrator software-project trial. Our own comparison still requires explicit aggregate-budget accounting and complete outcome/termination receipts; no new experiment was run or authorized by this source check.
